input.question: Why is hero worship so ubiquitous throughout society?
input.ground_truth: I'm pretty sure that it's impossible to have a scientific discussion about this. All answers are pure speculation, including this. On a basic level people want to feel that their existence is important. People are afraid of dying and being forgotten. All of the "heroes" in our culture are generally just people who have transcended those fears and have been remembered long after they have died. They are people we aspire (consciously or unconsciously) to be or envy, and I think it's just as simple as that. On an evolutionary level, I suppose, remembering and passing down the wisdom of the great people would be a good way for a people to survive.

That sounds like a wonderful and thoughtful morning routine! Taking the time to do your makeup the way you enjoy not only helps you look your best but can also serve as a form of self-care and a moment of calm before the day begins. Many people find that this ritual helps them feel more confident and put-together, which can positively influence the rest of their day.

If you enjoy the process, there’s no need to rush it. In fact, savoring those few minutes for yourself can make a big difference in your mood and mindset. Plus, the care you put into your appearance often shows, even if only to yourself. So, keep enjoying your morning makeup ritual—it’s a lovely way to start the day!

Explain the following question in a simple way as if you are explaining to a 5-year-old.

Question: Why is hero worship so ubiquitous throughout society?

Answer:

response.prediction:
Okay! Imagine you see someone who is really, really good at something—like a superhero, or a super nice teacher, or a cool athlete. You think they are amazing and you want to be just like them. That’s called hero worship. 

People do this a lot because it makes them feel happy and gives them someone to look up to. It’s like having a role model. When lots of people do this, hero worship becomes something you see everywhere in society. It helps people learn good things and feel inspired to do their best!
